test_message_mentions_bot: test the adapter._message_mentions_bot method detects real Telegram MENTION entities in message text
test_mention_at_start_of_message: test that a MENTION entity at the start of message text is correctly detected
test_mention_mid_sentence: test that a MENTION entity in the middle of a sentence is correctly detected
test_mention_at_end_of_message: test that a MENTION entity at the end of message text is correctly detected
test_mention_in_caption: test that a MENTION entity in a photo caption is correctly detected
test_text_mention_entity_targets_bot: test that a TEXT_MENTION entity targeting the bot's user ID is correctly detected
test_email_like_substring: test that an email-like substring foo@hermes_bot.example is rejected as a mention
test_hostname_substring: test that a hostname substring user@hermes_bot.domain.com is rejected as a mention
test_superstring_username: test that a superstring username @hermes_botx is rejected as a mention for @hermes_bot
test_substring_inside_url_without_entity: test that @handle inside a URL without a MENTION entity is rejected
test_mention_entity_for_different_userna: test that a MENTION entity for a different username is rejected
test_malformed_entity_with_negative_offs: test that a malformed MENTION entity with negative offset is rejected
test_uppercase_mention: test that an uppercase mention @HERMES_BOT is correctly detected case-insensitively
